attributes.label: Hotter, drier summers
attributes.description: Meteorological drought (KNMI'23): higher evaporation, summer precipitation deficit, and lower river discharge.

attributes.label: Sea-level rise
attributes.description: Rising sea level (KNMI'23 scenarios); increases hydrostatic pressure of marine water on polders and estuaries.

attributes.label: Wetter winters
attributes.description: Increased winter precipitation, providing potential recharge volume if retained.

attributes.label: Clay dispersion & sodification
attributes.description: Structural degradation of marine clay soils as sodium (Na+) replaces calcium (Ca2+) on clay complexes.

attributes.label: Crop water demand
attributes.description: Evapotranspiration and crop water requirement, peaking during hot, dry summers.

attributes.label: Estuary salt intrusion
attributes.description: Marine water penetrating further inland into estuaries and surface canals when sea levels rise and river discharge drops.

attributes.label: Freshwater lens recharge
attributes.description: Infiltration of winter rainwater that refills the shallow rainwater lens.

attributes.label: Freshwater lens thickness
attributes.description: Volume/thickness of the fresh rainwater lens floating on saline groundwater (1–2 m in low clay polders; 5–40 m in creek ridges).

attributes.label: Land subsidence
attributes.description: Peat oxidation and clay consolidation caused by low drainage levels, lowering the land surface relative to sea level.

attributes.label: Polder surface elevation (NAP)
attributes.description: Physical land surface elevation of the polder (-1.5m to -3.5m NAP), lowered by subsidence or raised via sedimentation.

attributes.label: Root zone salinity
attributes.description: Salt and chloride (Cl-) concentration in the crop root zone, causing osmotic stress and ion toxicity.

attributes.label: Saline seepage (kwel)
attributes.description: Upward hydrostatic pressure pushing salty groundwater through clay/peat layers (diffuse or via boils).

attributes.label: Soil structure & usability
attributes.description: Porosity, aeration, infiltration capacity, and workability of the agricultural soil.

attributes.label: Upconing of salt groundwater
attributes.description: Upward cone of the salt-freshwater interface beneath pumping irrigation wells as the freshwater lens thins.

attributes.label: Brackish irrigation water use
attributes.description: Emergency or forced use of salinised surface/groundwater for irrigation when fresh water is depleted.

attributes.label: Demand for deep polder drainage
attributes.description: Agricultural pressure to keep ditch water levels artificially low in spring so heavy machinery can access fields early.

attributes.label: External freshwater supply
attributes.description: Freshwater pipelines/canals from outside the region (present in Tholen/Zeeuws-Vlaanderen; absent on Walcheren, Bevelanden, Schouwen-Duiveland).

attributes.label: Freshwater availability for crops
attributes.description: Available fresh moisture in the root zone and from fresh irrigation sources during the growing season.

attributes.label: Freshwater storage measures
attributes.description: On-farm and sub-surface water retention: Freshmaker, ASR-Coastal, creek-ridge infiltration, and adjustable/smart drainage.

attributes.label: Groundwater extraction for irrigation
attributes.description: Pumping of freshwater from creek ridges and lenses by farmers during summer droughts.

attributes.label: Policy resistance & legal delays
attributes.description: Accumulated delays from lobbying, political deadlock, and Council of State (Raad van State) litigation.

attributes.label: Winter rain drained away
attributes.description: Winter precipitation rapidly discharged to sea via field drains and pumping stations instead of recharging the lens.

attributes.label: Wisselpolder land raising
attributes.description: Temporary tidal inundation along the Westerschelde allowing marine sediment to raise polder land by 1.5–3 m over 50–100 years.

attributes.label: Crop yield
attributes.description: Physical yield per hectare of conventional crops (potatoes, onions, sugar beet) under the prevailing salinity, freshwater and soil conditions.

attributes.label: Market demand for alternative crops
attributes.description: Consumer demand and offtake contracts for novel salt-tolerant or alternative crops (e.g. protein crops).

attributes.label: Processing capacity for alternative crops
attributes.description: Processing plants, breeding investment and supply chain infrastructure for novel salt-tolerant or alternative crops.

attributes.label: Salt-tolerant crop adoption
attributes.description: Cultivation of salt-tolerant varieties (potato/onion breeds) and halophytes/novel crops (quinoa, samphire, sea aster, field beans).

attributes.label: Agricultural land value
attributes.description: Market value of conventional farmland (€/ha), serving as the primary collateral for bank loans.

attributes.label: Bank credit freeze & risk premiums
attributes.description: Higher interest rates and tighter lending by agricultural banks when land collateral values drop or climate risks rise.

attributes.label: Basel IV capital requirements
attributes.description: European banking regulations requiring stricter risk weighting on loans when climate/soil risks reduce collateral value.

attributes.label: Dependence on high-margin salt-sensitive crops
attributes.description: Financial lock-in forcing farmers to grow high-revenue, salt-sensitive cash crops (seed potatoes, onions) to service high debt.

attributes.label: Farm revenue
attributes.description: Financial return per hectare from crop sales, determined by yield and prices.

attributes.label: Farmers' capacity to invest
attributes.description: Free cash flow and access to credit needed by farmers to pre-finance climate-adaptive practices.

attributes.label: Fear of expropriation & planning blight
attributes.description: Farmer anxiety over uncompensated land devaluation (planschade) and loss of autonomy (ontpolderen stigma).

attributes.label: Mortgage debt & financial leverage
attributes.description: Total bank debt per hectare (€/ha) and Loan-to-Value (LTV) ratio of agricultural enterprises.
